Two (2) years or more of Medical Assistant experience, preferably in a large, complex Healthcare system.

items.item_text: Certified Medical Assistant (CMA) OR Certificate of completion of a Medical Assistant training program.
BART or BLS at time of hire with commitment to get BART within six (6) months of hire date.
Must be able to work various hours and locations based on business needs.
Employment is subject to a criminal background check and a pre-employment physical.
Two (2) years or more of Medical Assistant experience, preferably in a large, complex Healthcare system.
Recent experience in a urology ambulatory care setting with a high procedural volume.
Experience with EPIC EMR and UCSD Purchasing and Supply systems or relevant systems.
Previous experience as a medical scribe or providing EMR documentation assistance for a Provider.
Experience with medication and durable medical equipment prior to authorizations.

Under the direct supervision of the Urology nurse manager, Urology nurse supervisor, and the general supervision of the clinic providers and licensed nursing staff, performs administrative tasks that require specific knowledge and training in patient care duties within business and professions code of the State of California and/or the regulations of The Joint Commission (TJC).

These duties also include but are not limited to: All aspects of back office medical assistant duties which include but are not limited to equipment management, environmental care functions, cleaning/disinfecting the environment, vital screening, medication review, documentation assistance for the providers, appointment scheduling, patient check-in, authorizations, accurate billing, payment processing, and supply and forms management.

Requires knowledge of medical terminology, procedures, universal precautions, and proper use of body mechanics. Position requires initiative, ability to prioritize demands, ability to work in a team environment, teamwork, and a positive attitude. Position also requires qualification to operate the scope processor, instrument handling for sterile processing, uroflow, bladder scanner, EKG, and other back office medical assistant equipment.
Strong computer literacy. Demonstrated proficiency in essential computer operations, including Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.).
Demonstrated knowledge and training in patient care, environmental care functions, equipment/supply management, and cleaning/disinfecting the environment.
Proven knowledge of online scheduling, universal precautions, and body mechanics.
Demonstrated ability to take initiative, prioritize demands and work in a team environment.
